title: Database Admin/Cloud Engineer
description:
Builds and operates the Azure platform that fmPilot 2\.0 migrates onto: Landing zone, networking, platform services, security baseline and monitoring. Partners with the DevOps engineer so every environment is reproducible through code.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 ‒ Design and provision Azure services for the platform: App Service, Functions, Azure SQL, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault
   

  

 ‒ Own networking: Virtual networks, subnets, private endpoints, network security groups, DNS and hybrid connectivity, including SFTP integration over VNet.
   

  

 ‒ Establish the security baseline: managed identities, role\-based access control, Azure Policy and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
   

  

 ‒ Build monitoring and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights and Log Analytics.
   

  

 ‒ Design for high availability and disaster recovery; manage capacity and cost.
   

  

 ‒ Support workload migration cutovers and troubleshoot platform issues across environments.
   

  

**Required Skills And Experience**
 ‒ Five or more years in infrastructure or cloud engineering with substantial hands\-on Azure experience.
   

  

 ‒ Deep knowledge of Azure platform\-as\-a\-service offerings and when to use each.
   

  

 ‒ Azure networking, including private endpoints, firewalls, DNS and hybrid connectivity to on\-premises systems.
   

  

 ‒ Identity\-aware infrastructure: managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault integration.
   

  

 ‒ Scripting with PowerShell or Azure CLI; working knowledge of Bicep or Terraform.
   

  

 ‒ Monitoring, alerting and incident response for production cloud workloads.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 ‒ Azure certifications such as AZ\-104 or AZ\-305\.
   

  

 ‒ Experience migrating .NET workloads from on\-premises or IaaS to Azure PaaS.
   

  

 ‒ Cost optimization and reserved capacity planning experience.

title: Lead Solutions Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Lead Solutions Engineer
   

  

**About The Job**
 Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.
   

  

 Join Sanofi as our
 **Lead Solutions Engineer** 
 to shape the future of pharmaceutical technology. Reporting to the Head of Solutions Engineering, you will serve as the technical lead for our Solutions Engineering practice and collaborate with Strategic Architecture and digital partners to drive Sanofi’s transformation into an AI\-powered biopharmaceutical company.
   

  

 This is a full\-stack engineering role that combines hands\-on expertise in cloud, DevOps, containers, and AI infrastructure with strategic vision\-setting. You will lead solution design discussions with Digital R\&D, Manufacturing, and Corporate teams, and establish technical patterns and standards to guide our global technology evolution.
   

  

**About Sanofi**
 We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
   

  

* This is a hybrid role with 3 days a week onsite in Hyderabad \- required. \*\*


**Main Responsibilities**
**Hands\-On Technical Implementation (70%)**
*Cloud\-Native Architecture \& Implementation*
* Design and implement hybrid cloud solutions on AWS and Azure for pharmaceutical workloads.
* Architect containerized applications using Kubernetes (EKS/AKS) with enterprise\-grade reliability.
* Build Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) for rapid, consistent deployments.
* Implement cloud\-native patterns (microservices, serverless, and event\-driven) that support pharmaceutical compliance.


*AI/ML Infrastructure Deployment*
* Deploy and optimize AI/ML infrastructure supporting drug discovery and manufacturing automation.
* Implement AIOps platforms for intelligent infrastructure monitoring and automated operations.
* Build data pipelines and model serving infrastructure for pharmaceutical AI applications.
* Design GPU\-optimized clusters and distributed computing environments for machine learning workloads.


*DevOps \& Automation Excellence*
* Implement CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, security scanning, and compliance validation.
* Design observability platforms that provide comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Build self\-service automation enabling digital teams to deploy infrastructure safely and rapidly.
* Establish GitOps practices and automated rollback mechanisms for pharmaceutical production systems.


*Hybrid Infrastructure Integration*
* Design seamless integrations between on\-premises pharmaceutical systems and cloud platforms.
* Build disaster recovery and business continuity solutions meeting pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.
* Optimize hybrid cloud costs through FinOps practices and automated resource management.


**Lead Strategic Technology Vision (30%)**
*Digital Partner Solution Design*
* Lead technical architecture discussions with Digital R\&D, Manufacturing, and Corporate peer organizations.
* Provide consultative guidance on cloud, AI, and infrastructure strategies for critical pharmaceutical initiatives.
* Co\-design enterprise solutions that balance innovation speed with GxP compliance requirements.
* Translate business challenges into technical solutions aligned with Sanofi’s AI transformation roadmap.


*Architecture Partnership \& Governance*
* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture on strategic technology initiatives and standards development.
* Provide solution\-level architectural decisions in line with enterprise architectural standards.
* Contribute to architectural decision frameworks for cloud, AI, and infrastructure domains.
* Aligning foundational technology capabilities with digital innovation requirements across the organization.


*Solutions Engineering Practice Development*
* Define technical patterns, standards, and best practices for the emerging Solutions Engineering team.
* Establish solution design methodologies that balance pharmaceutical compliance with innovation speed.
* Participate in hiring and developing additional Solutions Engineers across specialized domains.
* Create technical documentation, reference architecture, and implementation guides.


*AIOps \& Intelligent Operations Leadership*
* Design and promote AIOps capabilities for infrastructure and DevOps automation.
* Oversee implementation of intelligent monitoring, predictive analytics, and automated remediation. Collaborate with the agentic AI core team to integrate AI\-powered operations into the pharmaceutical technology stack.
* Drive adoption of ML\-powered capacity planning, anomaly detection, and self\-healing systems.


**About You**
**Required Experience:**
**Cloud \& Infrastructure Expertise**
* 8\+ years in enterprise infrastructure and engineering roles with increasing technical leadership
* Deep expertise in AWS and Azure with production\-scale implementations
* Advanced Kubernetes experience, including EKS/AKS in enterprise pharmaceutical or regulated environments.
* Hybrid cloud architecture integrating on\-premises systems with cloud\-native applications.
* Infrastructure fundamentals, including networking, storage, compute, and security at enterprise scale.


**DevOps \& Automation Mastery**
* Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent tools at scale.
* CI/CD pipeline design, including automated testing, security scanning, and compliance validation.
* Container orchestration with production Kubernetes implementations and cloud\-native patterns
* Observability platform experience, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing.


**Strategic \& Consultative Leadership**
* Cross\-functional collaboration guiding technical decisions across diverse business and technology teams.
* Standards development, creating technical patterns, and best practices adopted across organizations.
* Stakeholder communication, translating technical concepts for business leaders and non\-technical audiences.


**Highly Valued Experience**
* Hands\-on AI/ML infrastructure deployment, including model serving, training clusters, and data pipelines.
* AIOps implementation experience on AWS (CloudWatch Insights, Systems Manager, DevOps Guru, or equivalent)
* ML platform operations with experience in SageMaker, Azure ML, or similar enterprise ML platforms
* Intelligent automation, including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and automated remediation.
* Pharmaceutical or life sciences technology implementation with GxP compliance understanding
* Regulated industry background (healthcare, financial services, government) with validation experience
* Large\-scale digital transformations in organizations with 10,000\+ users
* Multi\-cloud governance and FinOps implementation with measurable cost optimization outcomes
* Site Reliability Engineering practices, including error budgets, SLOs, and incident management.
* Open\-source contributions to cloud\-native, Kubernetes, or AI/ML infrastructure projects


**Essential Capabilities**
**Technical Leadership**
* Lead complex technical discussions with confidence and credibility across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Challenge technical assumptions constructively while respecting domain expertise.
* Balance innovation adoption with operational stability and pharmaceutical compliance.
* Make sound architectural decisions in the face of ambiguity and incomplete information.


**Strategic Thinking**
* Connect technical solutions to pharmaceutical business outcomes and patient impact.
* Anticipate future technology trends and proactively prepare infrastructure capabilities.
* Design solutions that scale globally across diverse regulatory environments
* Balance short\-term delivery needs with long\-term architectural vision.


**Collaborative Influence**
* Build trust and credibility with digital peer organizations through consistent delivery.
* Navigate matrix organizations and drive consensus without formal authority.
* Partner effectively with Enterprise Architecture while maintaining a solutions delivery focus.
* Mentor and develop engineering talent through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.


**Communication Excellence**
* Articulate complex technical architectures clearly for both technical and business audiences.
* Create compelling technical documentation, reference architectures, and implementation guides.
* Facilitate productive technical discussions across distributed, global teams.


**Required**
**Education \& Credentials:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical field
* Equivalent: 8\+ years of Progressive cloud and technology engineering may substitute


**Preferred \& Valued**
* AWS certifications: Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, Machine Learning Specialty
* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert, AI Engineer Associate
* Kubernetes certifications: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer)
* Additional relevant certifications: Terraform Associate, TOGAF, ITIL, Agile/DevOps


**Reporting To**
* Head of Solutions Engineering (Technology Principal)


**Travel**
* Required for digital partner engagement and strategic initiatives (10%)


**Why This Role Is Unique**
**Foundational Impact**
* You are not joining an established team; you will be one of the first on a team tasked to build out the Solutions Engineering practice.
* Define standards, establish patterns, and create methodologies that will guide Sanofi’s technology transformation for years to come.


**Strategic Influence**
* Lead solution design with digital peer organizations supporting drug discovery, manufacturing automation, and regulatory compliance. Your technical decisions directly impact pharmaceutical innovation timelines and patient outcomes.


**AI Transformation Leadership**
* Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and AI\-powered operations. Design AIOps platforms that revolutionize how pharmaceutical technology operates while supporting our agentic AI transformation initiatives.


**Technical \& Strategic Balance**
* This role is both hands\-on and strategic. Spend 70% of your time building and implementing solutions, and 30% shaping technical vision and guiding digital partner organizations.


**Architecture Partnership**
* Work directly with Enterprise Architecture on strategic initiatives while maintaining a solutions delivery focus to accelerate pharmaceutical innovation. Connect enterprise standards with practical implementation.


**Why Choose Us?**
* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention, and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave.


 Sanofi Inc. and its U.S. affiliates are Equal Opportunity employers committed to a culturally inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; creed; religion; national origin; age; ancestry; nationality; marital, domestic partnership or civil union status; sex, gender, gender identity or expression; affectional or sexual orientation; disability; veteran or military status or liability for military status; domestic violence victim status; atypical cellular or blood trait; genetic information (including the refusal to submit to genetic testing) or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: AWS Solutions Architect – GenAI & Agentic AI
description:
**About Eficens** 




 Eficens is an AWS Advanced Tier Consulting Partner. We help growing businesses design, build and scale on AWS, with a strong focus on generative AI and agent\-based solutions.
 



**The role** 




 You'll be the technical lead for our customers. You'll own each engagement from the first technical conversation to an approved architecture: understanding the problem, designing the AWS solution, making the cost and security case, and handing a solid design to our delivery team. 
 



**What you'll do** 



* Run technical discovery with CTOs and engineering teams, and turn business goals into AWS architectures
* Design GenAI and agentic AI solutions on AWS: Amazon Bedrock (Agents, AgentCore, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails), RAG pipelines, SageMaker, and serverless services (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway)
* Build cost estimates and optimization plans, including costs specific to LLMs such as token usage, model choice, and throughput
* Design secure architectures from the start: IAM, KMS, VPC design, multi\-account landing zones, and data protection and guardrails for AI workloads
* Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework and run architecture reviews
* Prepare technical documentation for AWS partner programs, including MAP and GenAI program submissions
* Work with AWS account managers, partner managers and solutions architects on joint customer engagements
* Write reference architectures, solution briefs and technical case studies
* Stay current on AWS AI services and share what you learn with the team



**What we're looking for** 



* 3–5 years of hands\-on AWS experience, including at least 2 years designing solutions (not only operations or support)
* Has built at least one GenAI solution on AWS (Bedrock or SageMaker) and can explain the trade\-offs: RAG vs. fine\-tuning, model selection, cost vs. performance
* Solid understanding of AWS security and cost optimization best practices
* Able to explain technical designs clearly to both technical and business audiences
* Strong communication skills; comfortable leading calls with customers
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional preferred)
* Willing to work in US\-overlap hours (IST evenings)



**Good to have** 



* Experience at an AWS consulting partner, with exposure to ACE, MAP or Well\-Architected reviews
* Experience working with SMB customers
* AWS Certified Generative AI, Machine Learning or Security Specialty
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK or CloudFormation)
* Exposure to compliance frameworks such as HIPAA or SOC 2

title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
The Senior Cloud Platform Engineer designs, builds, and operates automated, secure, and scalable cloud platforms across AWS and Azure for enterprise clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role — owning landing zone architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, and observability — with the technical depth to troubleshoot production issues and the maturity to mentor junior engineers and influence platform standards across client engagements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform \& Landing Zone Engineering
* Design and build secure, multi\-account/multi\-subscription landing zones on AWS (Control Tower, Organizations) and Azure (Landing Zones, Management Groups).
* Implement network architecture — VPCs/VNets, transit gateways, hybrid connectivity, DNS, and security group / NSG design.
* Define and enforce account/subscription governance guardrails, tagging standards, and cost controls.
* Infrastructure as Code \& Automation
* Author and maintain infrastructure using Terraform (primary) and/or CloudFormation / ARM / Bicep, structured as reusable modules.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) for both infrastructure and application deployments.
* Drive GitOps practices for environment provisioning and change management.
* Containers \& Orchestration
* Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS) including networking (CNI), ingress, autoscaling, and RBAC.
* Support containerization of legacy and modernized workloads in partnership with application and modernization teams.
* Implement service mesh, secrets management, and workload identity patterns where applicable.
* Observability \& Reliability
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent.
* Define and track SLIs/SLOs for platform services; participate in on\-call rotation and incident response.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis for production issues and drive permanent fixes, not just workarounds.
* Security \& Compliance
* Implement identity and access management (IAM roles/policies, Azure AD/Entra ID RBAC), least\-privilege access, and secrets management (Secrets Manager, Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault).
* Embed security controls into pipelines (SAST/DAST, image scanning, policy\-as\-code with tools such as OPA/Sentinel).
* Support compliance requirements relevant to client engagements, including DPDP Act 2023, ISO 27001, and client\-specific regulatory frameworks under Minfy's Kavach360 programme.
* Cost \& Operational Efficiency
* Monitor and optimize cloud spend using native cost tools (Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management) and rightsizing recommendations.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual operational toil across managed environments.
* Client \& Cross\-Functional Engagement
* Work directly with client engineering and infrastructure teams as a trusted technical resource on managed services and migration engagements.
* Partner with the MiMo and Cloud Advisory teams to implement platforms that support migration and modernization roadmaps.
* Produce clear runbooks, architecture diagrams, and platform documentation.
* Mentorship \& Technical Contribution
* Mentor junior and mid\-level platform engineers; review their IaC and pipeline contributions.
* Contribute reusable modules, scripts, and accelerators to Minfy's internal platform engineering toolkit.
* Participate in architecture reviews and champion platform engineering best practices across the BU.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience
* 5–8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience operating production workloads on both AWS and Azure (multi\-cloud experience required).
* Core Technical Skills
* Strong hands\-on expertise with Terraform for multi\-cloud Infrastructure as Code.
* Production experience with Kubernetes (EKS and/or AKS) — deployment, troubleshooting, and day\-2 operations.
* Strong CI/CD skills — designing and building end\-to\-end pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or Jenkins) with automated testing, security gates, and deployment strategies (blue\-green, canary, rolling).
* Strong containerisation skills — Docker image build and optimization, multi\-stage builds, container registries (ECR, ACR), and container security scanning.
* Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automation and tooling.
* Solid networking fundamentals — VPC/VNet design, routing, DNS, load balancing, and hybrid connectivity.
* Security \& Governance
* Working knowledge of IAM/RBAC design, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code.
* Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise cloud environments (Well\-Architected Framework, ISO 27001, DPDP Act 2023 or equivalent).
* Collaboration \& Communication
* Comfortable working directly with client technical stakeholders and cross\-functional Minfy teams (advisory, MiMo, security).
* Able to produce clear technical documentation and communicate incident/root\-cause findings effectively.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer Expert, or CKA/CKAD.
* Experience with GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux).
* Exposure to service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
* Prior experience in a partner/SI or managed services environment (AWS Premier/Advanced Partner or Microsoft Solutions Partner).
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization.


**KEY COMPETENCIES**
* Ownership — treats production platforms as their own; drives issues to permanent resolution.
* Automation\-first mindset — defaults to codifying repeatable work rather than manual intervention.
* Technical depth with pragmatism — balances best practice with delivery timelines and client constraints.
* Collaboration — works effectively across client teams, internal BUs, and junior engineers.
* Continuous learning — stays current across a fast\-moving, multi\-cloud technology landscape.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability:
   

  

 –Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
   

  

 –Optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to support hyper\-scale systems.
   

  

 –Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
   

  

 –Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
   

  

 –Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large\-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
   

  

 –Design performance and load testing.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design:
   

  

 –Build and design fault\-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
   

  

 –Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
   

  

 –Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting.
   

  

 –Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance:
   

  

 –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
   

  

 –Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
   

  

 System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability:
   

  

 –Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
   

  

 –Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault\-injection, brown\-out) to evaluate system correctness.
   

  

 –Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
   

  

 Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management:
   

  

 –Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
   

  

 –Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
   

  

 –Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
   

  

 –Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
   

  

 –Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
   

  

 Compliance \& Security:
   

  

 –Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
   

  

 –Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
   

  

 –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
   

  

 Automation \& Change Management:
   

  

 –Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 –Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

 Planning \& Execution:
   

  

 –Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately\-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
   

  

 Collaboration \& Partnership:
   

  

 –Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
   

  

 Problem Solving:
   

  

 –Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
   

  

 Continuous Learning:
   

  

 –Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
   

  

 Continuous Improvement:
   

  

 –Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
   

  

 Performance and Development:
   

  

 –Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Services & Data Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Beyond Key**
 We are a Microsoft Gold Partner and a Great Place to Work\-certified company. "Happy Team Members, Happy Clients" is a principle we hold dear. We are an international IT consulting and software services firm committed to providing. Cutting\-edge services and products that satisfy our clients' global needs. Our company was established in 2005, and since then we've expanded our team by including more than 350\+ Talented skilled software professionals. Our clients come from the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, the Middle East, and India, and we create and design IT solutions for them. If you need any more details, you can get them at https://www.beyondkey.com/about.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role sits at the intersection of Platform and Data Engineering. You will be the primary custodian of our GCP environments, responsible for deploying, orchestrating, and securing not only our databases, but also the software systems and microservices that interface with them.
   

  

 Additionally, you will serve as our core GCP administrator, owning the full lifecycle of our cloud footprint. This includes provisioning new GCP projects, defining organizational hierarchies, and establishing enterprise\-grade security and permission boundaries.
   

  

 This is a highly autonomous, self\-managed role. We need an engineer who requires very little day\-to\-day management—someone who can architect infrastructure, write the necessary Terraform automation, secure the network perimeter, and safely deploy production\-grade software services, data platforms, and secure multi\-tenant GCP environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**GCP Tenant Administration, Software \& Service Deployment (Primary Focus)**
* GCP Project Provisioning \& Landing Zones: Own the end\-to\-end provisioning and lifecycle management of all new GCP projects. Establish, automate, and document standard "landing zones" (VPCs, Shared VPCs, logging buckets, and default security guardrails) for new application environments.
* Organization Hierarchy \& Governance: Manage the GCP Organization structure (Folders, Projects, Billing Account linkages) and implement Organization\-level policies to prevent misconfiguration or unauthorized resource exposure.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own the end\-to\-end design, implementation, and management of Terraform configurations to provision and manage all GCP resources (Projects, Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, VPCs, IAM, Cloud Storage, and data systems) in a repeatable and modular manner.
* Service Deployment \& Orchestration: Package, deploy, and manage containerized software services and systems. Optimize workload deployments using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, or instance templates, ensuring robust health checking, service discovery, and logging.
* CI/CD Pipeline Automation: Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, or similar) to support safe, zero\-downtime rollouts of software services, infrastructure updates, and database schema migrations.
* Monitoring, Alerting \& Observability: Implement comprehensive observability dashboards (using GCP Operations Suite/Stackdriver, Prometheus, or Grafana) to monitor system performance, application logs, service health, and infrastructure costs.


**Data Systems Engineering \& Security (Co\-Focus)**
* Multi\-Region Data Management \& Global Compliance: As a worldwide organization, managing multi\-region data architecture is a critical part of this role. You will architect, deploy, and maintain globally distributed databases while ensuring strict adherence to global security standards, data sovereignty laws, and regional data residency requirements.
* Identity Access Management (IAM) \& Security Governance: Enforce strict security boundaries across all projects, services, and data systems. Define, manage, and audit Google Group\-based memberships, apply least\-privilege IAM policies, configure service accounts, manage secret distribution (using GCP Secret Manager), and manage security policies (KMS encryption keys, VPC Service Controls).
* Database Provisioning \& Management: Plan, deploy, and configure high\-performing databases across various paradigms to support our transactional and analytical workloads:
* Relational workloads in PostgreSQL.
* Highly scalable, low\-latency NoSQL systems in GCP BigTable.
* Enterprise analytical data warehouse environments in GCP BigQuery.
* Database Performance \& Optimization: Manage schema migrations, create optimized table definitions, establish indexing/partitioning strategies, and tune queries to ensure cost\-efficient performance at scale.


**Self\-Management \& Collaboration**
* Autonomous Execution: Act as a self\-directed engineering unit. Take broad product and architectural requirements, translate them into technical implementation plans, and execute deployments with minimal supervision.
* Technical Ownership: Maintain comprehensive documentation of GCP network topologies, service architecture, and database configurations. Establish disaster recovery (DR) plans and perform root\-cause analysis on system or service failures.


**Required**
**Skills \& Experience**
* Work Experience: 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, or Data Infrastructure Engineering with a strong focus on cloud service deployment.
* GCP Cloud Ecosystem \& Administration: Extensive experience deploying and managing production software services and environments in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Proven experience handling GCP Organization\-level administration, folder structures, project billing setups, and resource hierarchy management.
* Identity \& Access Control: Deep expertise with GCP IAM (Identity \& Access Management), Service Accounts, workload identity federation, and defining complex permission policies.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Expert\-level proficiency writing clean, modular, and plan\-safe Terraform configurations to manage entire cloud footprints (including project creation and IAM policies via Terraform).
* Containers \& Orchestration: Strong experience deploying application services using Docker and orchestrating them via Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or Cloud Run.
* Data Systems Deployment: Hands\-on experience configuring, scaling, and securing:
* Postgres (operational/transactional environments).
* GCP BigTable (NoSQL / high\-throughput IoT telemetry storage).
* GCP BigQuery (analytical data\-warehousing and enterprise schemas).
* Cloud Security \& Networking: Solid understanding of cloud security architectures including VPC design, service accounts, private service connections, firewalls, and Organization\-level security guardrails.
* Programming \& Automation: Fluency in SQL and Python (or Bash/Go) for scripting, system automation, and pipeline integration.
* Self\-Direction: Demonstrated ability to manage workloads independently, prioritize tasks dynamically, and deliver production\-grade systems with minimal management overhead.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).


**Nice To Have**
* CI/CD Platforms: Advanced experience setting up complex deployment flows in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
* Data Streaming \& Pipelines: Experience with Pub/Sub, Kafka, or data pipelines (like Dataflow or Apache Beam) feeding into storage systems.


**Compliance Frameworks:** 
 Experience hardening infrastructure, IAM roles, and cloud services to meet SOC2, ISO 27001, or GDPR compliance.

 Technology Platform Engineer

 Creates production and non\-production cloud environments using the proper software tools such as a platform for a project or product. Deploys the automation pipeline and automates environment creation and configuration.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Oracle Utilities Customer to Meter C2M SPL

 NA

 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Technology Platform Engineer, a typical day involves designing and establishing both production and non\-production cloud environments tailored to project or product requirements. This role includes deploying automation pipelines to streamline processes and automating the setup and configuration of these environments. The position requires continuous collaboration with various teams to ensure seamless integration and efficient operation of the platform, supporting the overall technology infrastructure and enabling smooth project execution.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:

title: Tech Modernization – Senior Manager
description:
**Technology Strategy and Transformation – Senior Manager – Technology Modernization**
 Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients define and accelerate technology modernization journeys that unlock growth, simplify complexity and create future\-ready technology landscapes
   

  

**Practice:** 
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network
   

  

**Areas of Work:** 
 Technology Modernization Strategy, Application Modernization
   

  

**Level:** 
 Senior Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
   

  

**Years of Exp:** 
 15\+ years
   

  

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**
 Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growth? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choices? Do you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
   

  

 If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy \& Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise\-wide technology modernization strategies, target\-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C\-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business\-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.
   

  

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**
 Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.
   

  

 We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep\-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end\-to\-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high\-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:
   

  

**Modernization Strategy \& Value Agenda:** 
 Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes
 **Technology Estate \& Application Portfolio Assessment:** 
 Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non\-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio\-level priorities
 **Target Architecture \& Modernization Pathways:** 
 Shape target\-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation
 **Modernization Roadmap, Business Case \& Decision Governance:** 
 Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade\-offs and realize measurable business value
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy \& Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization\-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.
   

  

 The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.
   

  

 The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade\-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long\-term architecture fit.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap**
* Lead enterprise\-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes
* Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business\-aligned technology modernization priorities
* Assess current\-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems
* Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools
* Shape target\-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction
* Define modernization guiding principles, decision \& prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices
* Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners
* Build multi\-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness
* Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed\-to\-market


**Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture \& Planning**
* Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential
* Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non\-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities
* Define application modernization pathways for target applications
* Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options
* Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies
* Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity
* Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API\-led integration, microservices, event\-driven architecture, cloud\-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform\-based modernization
* Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future\-ready application architecture
* Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


**Executive advisory and Growth**
* Lead CxO\-level conversations on technology modernization priorities, application modernization choices, architecture implications, investment trade\-offs and enterprise transformation decisions
* Serve as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture and business leadership teams on modernization strategy, sequencing choices and strategic technology decisions
* Translate complex modernization and architecture topics into clear executive recommendations, decision options and leadership\-ready points of view
* Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated modernization propositions and executive\-ready solution narratives
* Shape client opportunities by bringing together various capabilities of Accenture to provide a holistic solution to client
* Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks
* Lead and mentor teams across discovery, modernization assessment, strategy development, roadmap creation and senior stakeholder engagement


**Core Skillsets \& Tools**
**Technology Modernization Advisory**
* Strong understanding of how enterprise technology modernization enables business growth, agility, resilience, cost optimization, speed\-to\-market and technology simplification
* Ability to assess complex technology estates across applications, platforms, integrations, data dependencies, AI, engineering, infrastructure touchpoints, cloud footprint, vendor ecosystem and technology debt
* Strong capability in legacy application modernization, technology debt assessment, modernization prioritization and investment sequencing across large enterprise landscapes
* Experience in developing modernization value cases that connect technology investments to measurable outcomes such as run\-cost reduction, risk reduction, improved resilience, faster change velocity and business capability enablement
* Familiarity operating model implications of modernization, including product\-centric delivery, platform operating models, engineering maturity, governance and change readiness
* Ability to define data, platform and architecture enablers required to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise value chain


**Application Architecture, Engineering and AI**
* Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data \& AI architecture, cloud architecture and transition architecture in modernization contexts
* Deep understanding of modern application architecture patterns such as domain\-driven design, modular architecture, microservices, event\-driven architecture, API\-led integration, cloud\-native application design and strangler\-based modernization
* Strong understanding of application modernization pathways including trade\-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity
* Experience with aging application estates, including non\-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end\-of\-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes
* Practical understanding of modern engineering practices such as AI driven SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, Kubernetes and platform engineering
* Strong understanding of frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, COBIT, IT4IT, business capability modelling, modernization maturity assessment and technology value assessment
* Good understanding of cloud, data and AI architecture concepts, including Azure/AWS/GCP, data lake, data fabric, real\-time data processing, semantic models, AI/ML integration, GenAI enablement and AI\-ready application architecture
* Familiarity with platform ecosystems across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, hyperscalers, integration platforms, data platforms, observability tools and engineering toolchains


**Consulting And Communication Skills**
* Strong consulting toolkit spanning structured problem solving, assessment design, facilitation, business case development and executive storytelling
* Ability to engage senior stakeholders with credibility and clarity, influence client leadership and create alignment across business and technology teams
* Experience in independently leading client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling modernization narratives and shape opportunities
* Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits and senior client relationship development


**Read More About Us.**
* The rise of forerunners
* Recent Blogs


**What’s in it for you?**
* An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


**About Accenture:**
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting:**
 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network – a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Our Capability Network teams complement our in\-country teams to deliver cutting\-edge expertise and measurable value to clients all around the world. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us\-en/Careers/capability\-network
   

  

 Accenture Capability Network \| Accenture in One Word
   

  

 At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference, come and be a part of our team.

 · AWS certification and experience with AI\-assisted engineering tools.

title: Application Engineer - III
description:
****About Vanguard****
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

****Role Summary****
* This role provides advanced\-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.


****About Team And Role:****
* We are looking for an experienced Server\-Side Python/AWS Developer to join a Full\-Stack team embracing New Ways of Working (NWoW) in Vanguard’s Global Investments Financial Systems (GIFS) division.
* We are rapidly expanding our technology presence in India, so this is an exciting opportunity to join the team, contribute to delivery, build technical depth, and gain exposure to the Investment Management apparatus at Vanguard.
* This team builds and supports the technology platforms that enable Vanguard’s Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) data capabilities. The team acquires, manages, enriches and distributes ESG data across the firm. This includes building data ingestion pipelines, APIs, cloud\-based data services and workflow capabilities that help ensure ESG data is accurate, secure, well\-governed and readily accessible to downstream consumers.
* This role focuses on building event\-driven, cloud\-native systems using Python and AWS, with particular emphasis on Amazon S3 (including Access Points) and DynamoDB, and orchestration via AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and ECS. The team uses agile methodologies and operates a continuous delivery pipeline.
* Good hands\-on experience implementing Python\-based services in a production environment is required. Practical knowledge of AWS or other cloud provider core services is expected.
* The successful candidate will be a motivated developer with strong problem\-solving skills, a commitment to quality, and good documentation and testing habits. This role requires strong communication and collaboration skills, as well as a proactive mindset—including asking clarifying questions, identifying edge cases, and surfacing risks early.
* The role includes daily interaction with business partners and product managers, making effective written and verbal communication essential.
* Join us and help us innovate for client success!


****In This Developer Role, You Will:****
* Collaborate closely with business users, product managers, and engineering partners \- actively asking questions and clarifying requirements to ensure high\-quality outcomes.
* Build and maintain Python\-based services on AWS, using event\-driven patterns tied to S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and ECS.


**Contribute To Data Architecture And Implementation Decisions, Including:**
* S3 buckets and Access Points
* Bucket/object modelling and partitioning
* DynamoDB and NoSQL data modelling
* REST / GraphQL APIs
* Encryption/KMS policies
* Performance and scalability considerations
* Integrate S3 and DynamoDB with event\-driven compute (Lambda), orchestrated workflows (Step Functions), and container workloads (ECS).
* Support end\-to\-end testing for event\-driven systems, including integration testing, schema validation, replay/idempotency scenarios, and testing across AWS services.
* Work with Avro for data serialization, including schema usage, schema evolution concepts, and Python libraries such as fastavro or avro.
* Maintain good engineering practices through clean code, code reviews, documentation, observability, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Provide 3rd\-line support as needed and contribute to continuous improvement.


**What It Takes:
   

  

 Technical Expertise**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back\-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.


***Python Development Experience, Including:***
* Object\-oriented programming
* Type hints and static analysis
* Packaging, virtual environments, and dependency management
* Concurrency (multiprocessing)
* Testing experience using pytest, unittest, and related frameworks


***Hands\-on Experience With Amazon S3, Including:***
* S3 Access Points and fine\-grained IAM controls
* Lifecycle rules, storage classes, multipart uploads


***Experience Working With NoSQL Databases Such As:***
* DynamoDB in AWS


***Experience With:***
* AWS Lambda (serverless patterns, event integration, concurrency \& retries)
* AWS Step Functions (workflow orchestration, error handling, compensating flows)
* Amazon ECS (task definitions, service scaling, container orchestration)


***End\-to\-end Testing Experience For Event\-driven Architectures:***
* Contract testing and integration testing concepts
* Avro schema validation and compatibility testing
* Integration tests across S3 → Lambda → Step Functions → ECS pipelines
* Monitoring and observability validation


***Experience Working With Avro:***
* Understanding of schema design and evolution strategies
* Efficient read/write using fastavro, etc.
* Handling large datasets and streaming workflows


***Experience With:***
* Experience with cloud\-native CI/CD, logging, and monitoring tools (Git/Bitbucket, CloudWatch, Splunk, etc.)


**Ways of Working**
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to a range of stakeholders.
* Proactive mindset: asks questions, uncovers assumptions, proposes solutions early, and takes initiative.
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritise effectively, and meet tight deadlines.
* Familiarity with agile practices and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

**Our mission**
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

**Our commitment to you**
 Vanguard Takes The Same Long\-term View Of Your Success—at Work And In Life—with Benefits And Rewards Packages That Reflect What You Care About, Throughout All The Phases And Stages Of Your Life. Our Total Rewards Programs Provide You And Your Loved Ones With Wellness Support For Key Areas In Your Life:
   

  

**Financial wellness**
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

**Physical wellness**
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

**Personal wellness**
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

****How We Work****
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle PAAS Admin \- Consultant, Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations maximize value from enterprise technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As a Cloud Technical Consultant within Managed Services, you will support clients in maintaining, enhancing, and optimizing cloud\-based solutions that enable business performance and operational continuity. This architect will be responsible for designing enterprise data models, defining metadata and governance standards, analyzing data quality issues, implementing MDM matching and survivorship strategies, evaluating emerging technologies, and enabling AI\-driven automation across the enterprise data ecosystem. * Develop and maintain the organization's IT architecture framework, ensuring alignment with business objectives, industry best practices, and emerging technologies.

* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Design end\-to\-end IT solutions, including infrastructure, applications, data, and security components, to support business processes and workflows.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance the organization's IT capabilities and drive innovation.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide guidance to development teams to ensure adherence to architectural principles, standards, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate architectural risks and issues through proactive planning and effective communication with stakeholders.
* Define and maintain documentation related to IT architecture, including diagrams, standards, policies, and procedures.

title: IBM Verify Identity Access Engineer
description:
IBM Verify Identity Access Platform Ownership

* Design and maintain Active\-Active (CRDB), Active\-Passive, multi\-region high\-availability topologies.
* Define and enforce sizing, capacity planning, persistence (AOF/RDB), eviction, and memory optimization strategies for mission\-critical workloads.
* Manage IBM Verify Identity Access Operator and related components Operators on Kubernetes, including CRDs, REC/REDB resources, rolling upgrades, and version lifecycle management.
* Perform performance tuning, latency analysis, and benchmarking to meet SLOs.
* Implement backup, restore, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity (BCP) procedures with documented RTO/RPO targets.



  





 Multi\-Cloud Infrastructure \& Kubernetes
 


* Build and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (VPC, EKS, IAM, KMS, Route53, PrivateLink) and Azure (AKS, VNet, Private Link, Key Vault, Entra ID).
* Operate Kubernetes clusters: networking (CNI), ingress, service mesh, storage classes, PV/PVC, node pools, autoscaling, and pod security.
* Manage container images, Helm charts, Kustomize overlays, and GitOps workflows (Argo CD/Flux) for IBM Verify Identity Access and supporting services.
* Ensure cross\-cloud connectivity, DNS, certificate management (cert\-manager), and secret management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault).



  





 Infrastructure as Code \& Automation
 



 Required \-
 


* Develop, review, and maintain automation modules for reproducible, environment\-agnostic
* provisioning across multiple deployment options (Kubernetes/OpenShift, AWS, Azure, etc.).
* Automate routine operations using Ansible, Python, Bash, or Go to eliminate manual toil.
* Maintain golden pipelines and reusable templates for infrastructure delivery.



  





 Preferred –
 



 Enforce IaC standards: module versioning, remote state, state locking, drift detection, and policy\-as\-code (OPA).
 



  





 GitLab CI/CD \& DevSecOps
 


* Design, build, and optimize GitLab CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure, configuration, and IBM Verify Identity Access platform deployments.
* Implement multi\-stage pipelines with linting, security scanning (SAST, IaC scanning, dependency scanning, secret detection), approvals, and progressive delivery.
* Manage GitLab runners (Kubernetes/Docker executors), CI variables, environments, protected branches, and deployment gates.
* Integrate automated testing, policy enforcement, and compliance checks into pipelines.
* Promote GitOps and trunk\-based development practices across the team.



  





 Observability, Reliability \& Performance
 


* Implement end\-to\-end observability using IBM provided tooling/metrics and/or Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/Loki, and APM tools (Dynatrace).
* Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for IBM Verify Identity Access services.
* Conduct capacity forecasting, load testing, and chaos engineering exercises to validate resilience.
* Drive continuous improvement of MTTD and MTTR through automation and runbooks. Incident \& Problem Management
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotation; lead response for Sev\-1/Sev\-2 incidents impacting IBM Verify Identity Access or dependent services (eg IBM Verify Directory).
* Drive incident command, communication, mitigation, and recovery in line with ITIL incident management practices.
* Maintain and continuously improve runbooks, playbooks, and on\-call documentation.



  





 Change \& Release Management
 


* Plan and execute changes following ITIL change management: RFCs, CAB reviews, risk assessment, rollback plans, and maintenance windows.
* Coordinate cross\-team release activities and communicate impact to stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate CMDB entries, configuration baselines, and dependency mappings for IBM Verify Identity Access assets and related supporting components.



  





 Security, Compliance \& Governance
 


* Implement security best practices: TLS in\-transit, encryption at rest, RBAC/ACLs, network policies, private endpoints, and least\-privilege IAM.
* Manage secrets rotation, certificate lifecycle, vulnerability remediation, and patching SLAs.
* Support audits and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR) with evidence and controls.
* Partner with security teams on threat modeling, hardening, and zero\-trust initiatives.



  





 Collaboration, \& Documentation
 


* Partner with application, data, SRE, security, and platform teams to onboard workloads onto IBM Verify Identity Access implementations with best\-practice patterns.
* Conduct code/IaC reviews and architecture reviews.
* Produce high\-quality technical documentation, ADRs, HLD/LLD diagrams, and knowledge base articles.
* Contribute to platform roadmap, backlog grooming, and quarterly planning.



  





 Continuous Improvement Innovation
 


* Evaluate new IBM Verify Identity Access features, modules, and emerging technologies as they become available in newer versions of the product suite.
* Drive automation\-first culture to reduce manual operations and improve developer self\-service.
* Identify and execute reliability, scalability, and performance improvement initiatives.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
* **About QUIPU**



 Quipu is AI infrastructure for long\-term memory, built for enterprises engineering complex systems—automotive, drug development, battery storage, and AI agents. We give every entity a single, audit\-grade memory so teams can study cause and effect rather than guess at it.
 



 That means vehicles with component\-level traceability and failure prediction, accelerated drug development with fewer risky experiments, battery systems with trusted cell\-ageing models, and agents with a shared persona that never resets.
 


* **Working Model — please read before applying**



 This is an on\-site role at T\-Hub, Hyderabad, on a 6\-day working week for the first 9 months. We're building core infrastructure to a hard timeline, and we'd rather be upfront about the commitment than surprise you later. After the initial 9 months, the schedule moves to a standard 5\-day week.
 


* **The Role**



 A Java backend engineer who thinks in systems, not just code. You'll own architecture decisions on core platform services—distributed microservices that handle graph storage, streaming ingestion, ETL pipelines, and semantic retrieval at scale—and you'll be expected to reason about trade\-offs and failure modes before writing a line of code.
 



**Experience required: 3–5 years of professional Java backend development. Applications with less than 3 years of professional experience will not be considered.** 



* **What You'll Do**



 •     Build and maintain Spring Boot microservices that form the core of a distributed graph memory platform
 



 •     Own product architecture decisions: service boundaries, data flow, failure handling, and evolution of the platform as it scales
 



 •     Design and implement security and access control in Java—authentication, authorization, multi\-tenant data isolation, and secrets management (Keycloak, Vault, or comparable)
 



 •     Work with event\-driven and streaming architectures—Kafka\-based pipelines, backpressure\-aware stream processing, and actor\-model concurrency
 



 •     Build and operate ETL and data ingestion workflows: extraction, transformation, validation, and loading across heterogeneous sources
 



 •     Model and query data across polyglot persistence: graph databases (Neo4j), distributed SQL (YugabyteDB), vector stores, and embedded key\-value stores
 



 •     Own features end\-to\-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production debugging
 



 •     Debug issues across the stack using logs, metrics, and traces
 



 •     Participate in design reviews and explain your technical decisions with clear reasoning
 


* **Must\-Have Skills**



 •     3–5 years of professional experience with Java and Spring Boot in production
 



 •     Solid grounding in core Java: collections, concurrency, JVM fundamentals
 



 •     Product architecture experience: designing service boundaries, reasoning about trade\-offs, and owning systems beyond individual features
 



 •     Working knowledge of security and access control in Java applications: authentication/authorization flows (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), role\- and attribute\-based access control, and secure API design
 



 •     Hands\-on production experience with Kafka or comparable event\-streaming platforms
 



 •     Experience building or operating ETL / data pipeline processes
 



 •     Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency models, partitioning, idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure handling
 



 •     Strong SQL skills and familiarity with at least one relational database
 



 •     Experience with at least one NoSQL or graph database
 



 •     Comfort reading logs, metrics, and traces to find root causes in running services
 



 •     Ability to reason about a system before coding it—design rationale, not just working code
 



 •     Available to work on\-site in Hyderabad, 6 days a week for the first 9 months
 


* **Strong Plus**



 •     Keycloak, HashiCorp Vault, or hands\-on IAM integration in production
 



 •     Experience with Akka or Apache Pekko (actors, streams, cluster)
 



 •     Graph databases (Neo4j, Cypher) or graph data modeling
 



 •     Distributed SQL databases (YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, Spanner\-class systems)
 



 •     Vector databases and semantic search pipelines (Milvus, pgvector, etc.)
 



 •     Python (FastAPI) for building service sidecars
 



 •     Exposure to LLM\-integrated systems: prompt pipelines, extraction workflows, RAG architectures
 



 •     Infrastructure familiarity: Jenkins, Docker, containerized deployments on Linux
 


* **Who You Are**



 •     You ask, "Why is the system shaped this way?" before asking, "What do I build?"
 



 •     You're comfortable with ambiguity and small\-team ownership—no hand\-holding, no rigid specs
 



 •     You debug from first principles and write down what you learn
 



 •     You communicate trade\-offs clearly and can disagree constructively in design discussions
 


* **What We Offer**



 •     Direct ownership of core infrastructure on a small team—your work ships and matters immediately
 



 •     Deep, unusual technical problems: bitemporal modeling, graph traversal at scale, streaming knowledge extraction
 



 •     Close mentorship from technical leadership on architecture and systems design
